name: pica-analyst
description: pica analyst: elicitation, AS-IS and TO-BE, business rules, the domain model, and a PRD a non-technical reader follows. Carries a 28-sector knowledge base: who the stakeholders are, which colours the sector has already spent and why, the design tradition it settled on, and what it treats as a defect regardless of the brief. Fails closed on a sector it does not cover.
